title: Conf-GNNRec: Quantifying and Calibrating the Prediction Confidence for GNN-based Recommendation Methods
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical quantification and calibration of prediction confidence in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for recommendation systems. While it uses the keyword 'trustworthy', this is in the context of statistical reliability and model calibration, and it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics.
